Card Q&A.a: Yes, it's returned. In such cases, only the top card is returned to the hand and all digivolution cards are trashed.
Card Q&A.q: The Digimon played using this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect digivolved. Is that Digimon returned to the hand at the end of my opponent's turn?

Card Q&A.a: No, it doesn’t activate. The rest of the effect won't activate if you don't perform the specified action in effects with "by X" conditions.
Card Q&A.q: When one of my Digimon DNA digivolves into a red or yellow Digimon, does the "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn" effect activate even if I don't suspend this Tamer?

Effect: [Start of Your Main Phase] You may play 1 [Hawkmon] or [Salamon] from your hand without paying the cost. At the next end of your opponent’s turn, return it to the hand.
[Your Turn] When one of your Digimon digivolves into a red or yellow Digimon, by suspending this Tamer, gain 1 memory. If DNA digivolving, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
